steps.en: Download the release compose file and .env, set the photo path and DB password, start it
steps.zh: 下载发布版 compose 和 .env，填照片路径和数据库密码，启动

steps.en: Register the admin in the web UI, then log in from the phone app with your server URL
steps.zh: 在网页端注册管理员，再用手机 App 填服务器地址登录

steps.en: Pick which phone albums to back up and turn backup on
steps.zh: 选好要备份的手机相册，打开备份

steps.en: The app uploads new photos in the background; the server stores originals and skips duplicates
steps.zh: App 在后台上传新照片，服务端保存原图并跳过重复

steps.en: Background jobs make thumbnails, transcode videos and read EXIF for the map
steps.zh: 后台任务生成缩略图、转码视频、读 EXIF 画地图

steps.en: The ML container finds faces and computes CLIP vectors, so text search finds photos by content
steps.zh: 机器学习容器识别人脸、算 CLIP 向量，文字就能按画面内容搜到照片

value.en: The family's whole photo library is searchable on your own disk, with no cloud subscription
value.zh: 全家的照片库在自己硬盘上就能按内容搜索，不再交云相册月费

sources: https://github.com/immich-app/immich/blob/main/docs/docs/install/post-install.mdx (register admin, mobile app login, mobile backup)
https://github.com/immich-app/immich#features (background backup, dedup, faces, CLIP search, EXIF map)
